parsed.post: Kept DEPTH=6: val_bpb 0.865187 (improved from 0.893788). Capacity scaling is clearly working well alongside the full data shards. Next, I will test a slightly higher learning rate (0.07) to see if we can optimize convergence further without the instability seen at 0.1.
